decision: Started the Last Keep v1 run from CONCEPT.md and an empty repo
why: The owner asked for a playable co-op game, tests, and a deploy to agentyard.letz.tw

decision: Done means the site serves the game, a WebSocket joins a room, CI is green, and the PR is merged
why: Those are the checks the owner named

decision: One pure State and a Sim.tick reducer inside a room GenServer
why: The owner fixed the process model, and a second design pass would restate it

decision: Full JSON snapshots at 20 Hz, public player ids, secret reconnect tokens
why: Deltas and shared tokens were the wrong risks for fifteen players

decision: Installed pstack with npx skills add backnotprop/pstack --agent cursor --copy
why: Future agents in this repo need the skills, and the CLI wrote them to .agents/skills

decision: Kept hero kits, wave plans, and building costs in tables
why: The tick should read data instead of growing a new branch per hero

decision: The game-over overlay was painting over the match because display:grid beat the hidden attribute
why: Clicks missed the join form and the canvas read as black

decision: Dusk lighting stays readable after the Lambert 1/pi shade, and trees sit inside the first camera view
why: A black frame is not a playable keep

decision: Build highlight updates from the key and click that change it
why: A 100ms repaint was only there to refresh that highlight

decision: Wave-1 goblins render on the yard, and an invite with name and hero joins at once
why: A missing facing made the mesh rotation NaN, spawn sat outside the camera, and the join page ignored the query

decision: The night waits for the host, goblins stand on the yard inside a keep-centered camera, and a tap places or attacks
why: The browser proof counted a crest while heroes stood still, so edge labels and a missed click still wiped a real pair of players

decision: Hits and deaths float, Fireball stays on screen for a tick before it can burst, and a wall is a separate click that disarms
why: A playtest spent wood with no new building, missed the fireball, and watched the wave label flip

decision: Wave 1 is a short slow bite, hits rise and fade, the score stays on the HUD, and the interaction graph is checked against the sim
why: A production pair lost the keep on the first night, could not read the stuck damage number, and needed two clicks to place a wall

decision: Adopted Kingdom Two Crowns in a 3D/HD-2D world as the design reference for world scale, day/night frontier, coherent terrain, and wave 4+ threats
why: Review showed 7200-radius white-noise world clashed with 25-35s build phases, flat 60s Frenzy, and AFK wave 2-5 clears

decision: Guarded restart to :over, migrated host to lowest connected seat, wired +6% party HP scaling, rekindled outer portal when all 6 fall, and fixed local tsc/esbuild hygiene
why: Closed TLC NoRestartBeforeTheFall, lobby host deadlock, WORLD.md party scaling gap, empty-portal infinite score loop, and dev build errors

decision: Merged main into PR #167 (painted building footprints) and fixed far-face feed reach, invisible polygon shadow material, and precompiled Footprint edges
why: Keep footprint extends past radius 100 so old feed reach broke on far face; footprintGeometry lacked UVs for radial contactTexture; sim ticked Footprint polygon conversion every step

decision: Fixed title keep clipping (LK-128), outer scenery bar glitches (LK-129), outer horizon night parity & blur (LK-130), and map cloth marks (LK-106)
why: Independent Chrome click-test revealed keep clipping hero on title screen, legacy 5-bar scenery cutout, bright blurry daytime horizon clashing with dark night yard, and merged map cloth mark

decision: Shipped Milestone 2 diegetic clarity (LK-119) and mobile touch button/cost polish (LK-131): Spire icon, Stone & Stone Wall HUD, [F] Feed prompt, Mage Meteor lock feedback, build-ghost parity + right-click cancel, and /r/CODE party preview
why: Closed all P1 HUD/UX gaps from ROADMAP.md and the Chrome QA playtest while preserving CHROME_BUDGET = 10 and 3-sack layout
